info.text:
In one experiment, card payers bid double for the same Celtics tickets.
In that 2001 study, cash bidders averaged $28.51 and card bidders $60.64.
Researchers call it the pain of paying: handing over cash can sting, while a swipe may barely register.
The Fed's payment diary shows cash fell from 31% of US consumer payments in 2016 to 14% in 2025.
Sources: Prelec & Simester, Marketing Letters (2001); Knutson et al., Neuron (2007); Federal Reserve Diary of Consumer Payment Choice.
News and education, not financial advice.
